description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search verified space supply-chain relationships backed by confirmed USAspending federal subawards or accepted SEC annual-report statements. Every link carries its primary evidence and source URL. Filter by company, role and evidence source.

company.description: Company name or profile slug (matches supplier or customer).

limit.description: How many relationships to return (1 to 25).

offset.description: Relationships to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

role.description: Match company as supplier, customer or either.

source_kind.description: Filter by evidence source: USAspending subaward, SEC annual report or both.

name: sourced_supply_chain
title: Sourced supply chain
